title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 19: Elijah's flight from Jezebel, the angel's food, the still small voice at Horeb, and the call of Elisha.

questions.text: Who sent a messenger to Elijah threatening to take his life by the next day?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:2 says Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying she would make his life as the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time.

questions.text: Under what kind of tree did Elijah sit down and ask to die?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:4 says he went a day's journey into the wilderness and sat down under a juniper tree.

questions.text: What did Elijah find at his head when the angel touched him?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:6 says there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water.

answers.text: A cake baked on the coals and a jar of water
Bread and meat left by ravens
A jar of meal and a jar of oil
Honey and figs in a basket

questions.text: How long did Elijah travel in the strength of that food to reach Horeb?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:8 says he went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, God's Mountain.

questions.text: What question did Yahweh ask Elijah at the cave?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:9 says Yahweh's word came to him and said, "What are you doing here, Elijah?"

questions.text: What came after the wind, the earthquake, and the fire?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:12 says that after the fire there was a still small voice.

questions.text: What did Elijah do when he heard the still small voice?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:13 says he wrapped his face in his mantle, went out, and stood in the entrance of the cave.

answers.text: Fell asleep again in the cave
Wrapped his face in his mantle

questions.text: Whom was Elijah to anoint to be king over Syria?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 19:15 Yahweh tells Elijah to go to the wilderness of Damascus and anoint Hazael to be king over Syria.

questions.text: How many in Israel did Yahweh say he had kept who had not bowed to Baal?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 19:18 Yahweh says, "I reserved seven thousand in Israel, all the knees of which have not bowed to Baal."

questions.text: What was Elisha doing when Elijah found him?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 19:19 says Elisha the son of Shaphat was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth.

answers.text: Plowing with twelve yoke of oxen
